The compound is **4-amino-3-(2-methoxyphenyl)-5-methyl-6-phenyl-7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine-2-thione** (PubChem CID 3004447; ChEMBL CHEMBL1966530).

Thus, the queried data provide no documented HIV antiviral bioactivity. They also do not establish a validated prediction that this compound inhibits HIV replication. Its drug-like physicochemical properties are not evidence of antiviral activity.
